name: print-social-new-tech-new-rules-posts-magenta-blue-vr-duotone
title: 'New Tech, New Rules' pack with magenta-blue duotone VR headset photos over navy split banners
whatItIs: Five square posts with magenta-to-blue duotone photos of a man wearing a VR headset, split horizontally by a navy-to-red banner holding bold white 'New tech, new rules' text, social icons and a website line.
whatItMeans: Bold and futuristic; the split banner format keeps a consistent brand structure while the duotone photo carries all the visual excitement.
techniques: Split each post horizontally between photo and solid banner.
Duotone the photo in two clashing neon colours.
Keep the banner text and layout identical across variations.

vocabulary.definition: A layout divided into a photo area and a solid text banner.
An image rendered using only two colours.
